blocks.text: Kisi compound ki lattice energy ek seedhe tajurbe (experiment) se maloom karna na-mumkin hai. Lekin kai tajurbati values aur ek energy cycle, jise Born–Haber cycle kehte hain, se ΔH°latt nikal sakte hain. Born-Haber cycle Hess’ law ka hi ek istemal hai. Aayiye Hess’ law aur Born-Haber cycle se sodium chloride ki lattice energy nikalte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen halke neele dabbon ka tikon: Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) (oopar baen), Na+Cl-(s) (oopar daen) aur Na+(g) + Cl-(g) (neeche). Oopar baen se oopar daen teer: delta H(o)f. Anasir se neeche gaseous ions tak teer: delta Hx. Gaseous ions se oopar Na+Cl-(s) tak teer: delta H(o)latt.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.8: Sodium chloride ka enthalpy cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Elements Na(s) + ½Cl₂(g) se NaCl(s) tak do raste hain: seedha (ΔH°f), ya pehle gaseous ions Na⁺(g) + Cl⁻(g) banana (ΔHx) aur phir ions se solid banana (ΔH°latt). Is liye ΔHx + ΔH°latt = ΔH°f.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.8 mein oopar daen khana 'Na⁺Cl⁻(g)' chhapa hai aur ΔH°latt ka teer solid se gaseous ions ki taraf hai. Lattice energy gaseous ions se solid banne ki tabdeeli hai, is liye sahi khana Na⁺Cl⁻(s) aur teer ions se solid ki taraf hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.

items: ΔH°f: NaCl ki standard enthalpy of formation, jo calorimeter mein aasani se napi ja sakti hai.
ΔHx: sodium aur chlorine ko un ki standard physical states se gaseous ions banane mein lagne wali kul energy. Is cycle par Hess’ law lagayen to:

blocks.text: Is energy triangle ko phaila kar ΔHx ke saare qadam dikhaye gaye hain. Yeh mukammal energy cycle Born-Haber cycle kehlata hai (Figure 6.9).

blocks.alt: Born-Haber energy seerhi (paimane par nahi). Mote reactants level Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) se: delta Hat of Na = +108 kJ mol-1 oopar Na(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g) tak; delta Hi of Na = +496 oopar Na+(g) + e- + 1/2 Cl2(g) tak; delta Hat of Cl2 = +121 oopar Na+(g) + e- + Cl(g) tak; delta Hea of Cl = -349 neeche Na+(g) + Cl-(g) tak; phir mota teer neeche, delta Hlatt of Na+Cl-(s) = ? (NaCl ki lattice energy), aakhri product Na+Cl-(s) tak. Reactants se seedha teer neeche Na+Cl-(s) tak: delta Hf = -411 kJ mol-1.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.9: Sodium chloride ka Born-Haber cycle (paimane ke mutabiq nahi) (kitab ki Figure 6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seerhi ke har qadam ek tabdeeli hai: sodium ka atom banna (+108), us ka ion banna (+496), chlorine ka atom banna (+121) aur chlorine ka electron lena (–349). Oopar jayen to energy jazb, neeche aayen to kharij. Dono raste barabar hain, is liye lattice energy = –411 – 376 = –787 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.9 mein pehle qadam ke baad 'Na⁺(g) + ½Cl₂' chhapa hai (sahi: Na(g) + ½Cl₂(g)) aur sab se oopar 'Cl₂(g)' (sahi: Cl(g)). Oopar diagram mein dono sahi hain.

blocks.caption: Born-Haber cycle of NaCl (Figure 6.9), kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Sample problem 6.9
blocks.problem: Sodium fluoride (jo sodium chloride jaisi lattice mein crystallize hota hai) ki heat of formation nikalein. Na(s) ki heat of atomization 109 kJ/mol, F₂(g) ki aadhi bond energy 79 kJ/mol, sodium atoms ki ionization energy 494 kJ/mol, fluorine atoms ki electron affinity –328 kJ/mol, aur lattice energy –939 kJ/mol hai.
steps: Born-Haber cycle ki saari values di gai hain, is liye Hess’ law lagate hain:
ΔH°f = ΔH°latt + ΔH°at (Na) + ΔH°1i (Na) + ΔH°at (F₂) + ΔH°1ea (F)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab jawab ki satar mein sirf 'Δ = –585' likhti hai; poori alamat ΔH°f hai: ΔH°f (NaF) = –585 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: a) Sodium fluoride (Sample problem 6.9) ki Born-Haber cycle banayein.
blocks.explanation: Neeche Na(s) + ½F₂(g) (reactants). Oopar ki taraf: Na(s) → Na(g) (+109), Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻ (+494), ½F₂(g) → F(g) (+79). Phir neeche: F(g) + e⁻ → F⁻(g) (–328), aur Na⁺(g) + F⁻(g) → NaF(s) (–939). Sab ka jama –585 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, jo seedhe raste Na(s) + ½F₂(g) → NaF(s) ki ΔH°f hai.

answer_figure.alt: Sodium fluoride ki Born-Haber cycle (scale ke mutabiq nahin). Neeche mota level Na(s) + ½F₂(g) (reactants). Oopar teer: ΔHat Na = +109, ΔHi Na = +494, ΔHat F (½ B.E. of F₂) = +79 kJ mol⁻¹, sab se oopar Na⁺(g) + e⁻ + F(g). Daen neeche teer ΔHea F = −328 tak Na⁺(g) + F⁻(g), phir mota teer lattice energy −939 tak NaF(s). Surkh teer reactants se NaF(s): ΔHf = −585 kJ mol⁻¹.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: sample problem 6.9 ke data se sodium fluoride ki Born-Haber cycle (scale ke mutabiq nahin)
answer_figure.long_description: Yeh Figure 6.9 (NaCl) jaisi cycle hai, magar NaF ke data ke saath. Reactants Na(s) + ½F₂(g) se teen qadam oopar jate hain: sodium ka atomization (+109), sodium ki ionisation (+494) aur fluorine ka atomization, yani F₂ ki bond energy ka aadha (+79 kJ mol⁻¹). Phir F(g) electron le kar F⁻(g) banta hai (electron affinity −328) aur gaseous ions mil kar NaF(s) crystal banate hain (lattice energy −939). Seedha raasta, surkh teer, formation ki enthalpy hai: −939 + 109 + 494 + 79 − 328 = −585 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: b) Lithium fluoride ki heat of formation nikalein: Li(s) ki atomization 161, F₂ ki aadhi bond energy 79, lithium ki ionization energy 520, fluorine ki electron affinity –328, lattice energy –1107 kJ/mol.
blocks.explanation: ΔH°f = ΔH°latt + ΔH°at(Li) + IE(Li) + ΔH°at(F) + EA(F) = –1107 + 161 + 520 + 79 – 328 = –675 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab lattice energy '1107 kJ/mol' (baghair manfi nishan ke) likhti hai. Lattice energy mein energy nikalti hai, is liye yeh –1107 kJ/mol hai.

items: Born-Haber cycle: ionic solid par Hess’ law; ΔHx (atomizations + ionization + electron affinity) + ΔH°latt = ΔH°f.
